name: Ko'oni
source:
A small, masked child that suddenly appeared before Saki's eyes, Ko'oni disappears just as quickly. It becomes apparent that Ko'oni doesn't allow himself to be seen by anybody other than Saki. He also seems to know a great deal about Saki and the residents of the mansion in Hanari...

[Translation of the [URL=http://www.mead-soft.net/sakuragatari/character.php]official website's[/URL] character profile.]
